A type of titanic '''cetacean''' lived on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] [[Doreen]]. The [[Cetacean/Legends|cetaceans]] vomited up the substance known as [[Doreenian ambergris]], which was valued by many offworld perfumers.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
